title: Icehouse — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete independent icehouse interpretation for the photographed gabled service outbuilding: low weathered log shell, steep gray board roof with closed undersides/edge thickness, horizontal timber gables, genuine recessed low braced door and triangular gable vent, corner log ends and one supported threshold. Function, photo-side assignment and geographic precision remain explicit inferences. No trees, exhibition contents, signs, copied pixels or speculative underground chamber.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Two ordinary courtyard photos show the same independent low log outbuilding with steep weathered board gable roof, horizontal timber gable, small triangular vent and braced low door immediately beside the kitchen. The aerial roof northeast of the kitchen supplies approximate center[37.526115,54.076448] and southwest-facing gable axis. Assignment as the icehouse rather than woodshed remains an explicit estate-context inference: the photographs are grouped under kitchen and do not label this outbuilding individually. This is an original specific exterior interpretation, not a generic icehouse preset. Standard PMTiles/current OSM omit its footprint; own or replace no native building. Position about5m/facing20degrees are author estimates, not measured bounds.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Photo-led7.8x5m plan,1.75m low log walls and4.1m steep ridge above a level entry floor. Door.95x1.55m and small triangular vent. Ground contact follows the outside front entry sample plus.08m, allowing native soil around the low sides rather than raising a large plinth. Exact dimensions, roof material/date, hidden rear and historic cold-chamber depth remain reconstructed; no underground room is authored.
